meta.title: Peppobot
meta.description: Every game Peppobot runs. Scored on six axes, reviewed without filters, tracked to the hour.

hero.intro: Every game Peppobot runs. Scored on six axes, reviewed without filters, tracked to the hour.

axes.name: Gameplay
axes.note: Moment-to-moment feel: controls, systems, combat, puzzles. Does it play well?

axes.name: Visuals
axes.note: Art direction first, raw tech second. Does it look like nothing else?

axes.name: Audio
axes.note: Soundtrack, sound design and voice work. Does it stay in my head?

axes.name: Genre · I
axes.note: The first criterion of the game's genre: what its kind lives or dies on.

axes.name: Genre · II
axes.note: The second criterion of the game's genre.

axes.name: Signature
axes.note: What only this game does. The thing it will be remembered for.

telemetry.
telemetry.profileIntro: Peppobot's taste fingerprint — the six axes averaged across every completed run.

title: Scoring
protocol.
protocol.intro: Every game is rated 0–10 on six axes. The final score is the plain average — no hidden weights, no publisher pressure. Games still in progress get no score until the credits roll.

axisCards.name: Signature
axisCards.note: Exclusive to this game: the one thing that defines it, scored on its own. Every game gets a different one.

protocol.aboutText: Peppobot is a human with a robot's patience for completion screens. Plays mostly RPGs, roguelikes and anything with a good parry. Reviews are written after the credits, never before.
